study: Recent radar history for tornado detection
status: Designed and catalog verified; adaptation runs not performed

data.name: MIT TorNet
data.sampling: 2014-2015 source-test examples after source-train episode/event and proximity exclusions; no class balancing or model-score selection
data.pretraining_catalog_exclusion: Discard every selected clip whose episode_id or event_id appears in any2013-2022 source train row, including authors validation years
data.label: Provided binary tornado-present label for terminal frame
data.grouping: Complete episode IDs connected by any shared UTC input-window date
data.split_rule: Seeded metadata-only stratification of48storm groups into28train,10validation,10test groups; target sample fractions0.6,0.2,0.2

model.pooling: global maximum over spatial dimensions, 384 features per frame
model.preprocessing: Original TorNet normalization, NaN filling, range-fold mask, range/inverse-range coordinates
model.pretraining_independence: Authors documented source test exclusion plus episode/event and proximity filtering; checkpoint has no split metadata and other episodes on same weather days may have been seen
model.feature_extraction_mode: Evaluation/inference mode; dropout disabled; all backbone parameters frozen

training.standardization: Fit one384-dimensional scaler on current training embeddings; apply same scaler to both frames before temporal averaging
training.base_loss: Train-derived class-balanced BCE; sample weights normalized to average1
training.checkpoint: Earliest epoch with maximum validation average precision
training.weight_definition: N/(2*N_class) per example; multiply WRN,label0 weight by2 only in hard_negatives; normalize training weights to mean1
training.validation_loss: Unweighted BCE for comparable validation curves; weighted BCE separately identified for training
training.batch_order: Use same training sample order and same initialization for all linear heads within each seed

experiments.name: history
experiments.head: linear
experiments.change: Temporal averaging only, identical384 inputs and385 head parameters

experiments.name: hard_negatives
experiments.head: linear
experiments.change: Relative loss weight of WRN examples with label0 only

evaluation.selection: Find best mean validation AP across three seeds; candidates within0.01absolute of best prefer fewer head parameters,then single frame,then original run order
evaluation.deployable_model: Average sigmoid scores of all three saved heads of the selected configuration
evaluation.threshold: Choose highest observed validation score attaining >=0.80 recall using score>=threshold and retaining ties; separately freeze for each scored reference before final test
evaluation.final_test: Evaluate locked winner and predeclared reference models once; never test all unselected configurations or tune from test
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired storm-group bootstrap on saved final predictions,1000draws,seed42; report valid draw count and percentile95% intervals; no significance claim from only10test groups
evaluation.radar_statistics_baseline: Train-only standardized current-frame DBZ95thpercentile,DBZfraction>=40dBZ,VEL95thminus5thpercentile,RHOHV5thpercentile,ZDRmedian,KDP95thpercentile,WIDTH95thpercentile,radar_range; each scalar over both tilts ignoring masked cells; train-median imputation; sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1,class_weight=balanced,max_iter=1000,random_state=42)
evaluation.calibration: Class-weighted sigmoid scores are not calibrated operational probabilities

pre_training_checks: Actual NetCDF labels both classes in each split and at least40positive clips and8positive storm groups in validation and finaltest
At least3warning-negative storm groups in each evaluation split
Per-frame timestamps strictly ordered; prior-to-terminal gap3to7minutes; exclude failed-history examples from ALL configs equally
No frame later than terminal as input; terminal target from supplied labels, never category name as label
No category,filename,episode,event,EF number or warning geometry supplied to model
Unchanged CNN score reproduced on a documented example before extracting features
Previous/current feature arrays and manifest sample IDs exactly aligned
One pilot head run completes within10minutes; retain all chronological failures and timing
limitations: Retrospectively selected radar crops; not operational storm discovery or advance tornado prediction
Only two years,48storm-day groups and selected storm cases; curated prevalence differs from real warning deployment
Source category counts are not audited per-frame positive counts
Model training provenance relies on authors protocol rather than checkpoint metadata
Frozen image features may fail to encode useful five-minute evolution
Temporal averaging tests persistence/smoothing rather than learning a directional storm trajectory
Loss weighting may reduce false alarms while also increasing missed tornado cases
